scripts.build:bin: npm run build && ~/.bun/bin/bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile out/music-library --target bun-darwin-arm64 2>&1 || ~/.bun/bin/bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile out/music-library && cp -r dist out/dist 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:bin:all: npm run build && ~/.bun/bin/bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile out/music-library-macos --target bun-darwin-arm64 && ~/.bun/bin/bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile out/music-library-linux --target bun-linux-x64 && ~/.bun/bin/bun build --compile server/index.ts --outfile out/music-library.exe --target bun-windows-x64 && cp -r dist out/dist 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production NO_OPEN=1 node --import tsx server/index.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
